resource_details.description: A master compendium of logic puzzles and advanced probability problems scraped from historical interview panels at tier-one financial institutions. Serves as the definitive preparation resource for quantitative finance and data science roles at IIT KGP.
core_theoretical_topics: Mathematical expectations for complex stochastic processes
Statistical paradoxes (Monty Hall problem, Birthday Paradox, etc.)
Mental math and rapid calculation under duress
Risk calculation and expected value optimization
recommended_supplementary_literature: Fifty Challenging Problems in Probability (Frederick Mosteller)
Communique handbook: The Guessing Game (for Guesstimates)
Heard on the Street (Timothy Crack) for quant interviews
